author: NASASpaceflight
description:
Starship Flight 12 is almost here.

This week on Starship Update, SpaceX prepares Ship 39, Booster 19, and Pad 2 for Starship’s twelfth flight test—with one final Wet Dress Rehearsal, new FAA licensing approval, updated launch timelines, and major new details about Starship Version 3.

We break down everything changing for Flight 12, including:
🚀 Raptor 3 full simultaneous ignition
🚀 Brand-new southeast launch trajectory
🚀 22 Starlink V3 simulator deployments
🚀 In-space Raptor relight test
🚀 New landing burn profile
🚀 Booster 19 splashdown instead of catch attempt
🚀 Ship 39’s upgraded systems for future lunar and Mars missions

Plus:
🌎 Marmac 31 ("You'll Thank Me Later") gets major upgrades for transport
🌴 LC-39A construction and chopsticks testing in Florida
🛠 Roberts Road Gigabay progress
🦅 McGregor Raptor 3 engine testing
📍 And… SpaceX may be planning a future Starship launch site in Louisiana?!

Flight 12 is shaping up to be one of the most important Starship flights yet as SpaceX
title: One Last Test Before Launch? | Starship Update
